name: Must Love Otters
source:
Running from your old life leads you to what should be a relaxing resort— except for the rugged, charming, and infuriating concierge Ryan Fielding. Will a fateful adventure with this former NHL player land you right in his waiting arms?

[From in-app]
translation:
为了逃离过去的生活，你来到一座本该让人放松的度假村——可那里却有个粗犷迷人、又令人恼火的礼宾员瑞安·菲尔丁。与这位前NHL球员共同经历一场命中注定的冒险后，你会投入他早已为你敞开的怀抱吗？

[译自应用内简介]
